full_suite.reason: RC3 smoke failed and the profile requires an immediate stop.

package_change_rationale: The skill requires trusted host pre-validation before reasoning, but the adapter defines no model-visible, deterministic host-attestation contract. Under the strict four-file profile the model failed closed and emitted an invalid placeholder request digest.
recommended_next_action: Define a minimal trusted host-validation attestation in the Codex adapter contract, version the package, then run one new isolated GOLD-001 smoke without exposing validator source or expected results.
